evals.prompt: I want to start on the bulk-export feature without messing up my current branch, I've got uncommitted stuff here. Set me up a separate workspace.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks for existing isolation, prefers a native worktree tool if available, otherwise creates a git worktree in an ignored directory without touching the user's uncommitted changes, installs dependencies, and records a baseline.
expectations: Runs a detection check (git-dir vs git-common-dir or equivalent) before creating anything
Uses the harness's native worktree tool if one is available, otherwise `git worktree add` with a new branch
Verifies the worktree directory is ignored (git check-ignore) and ignores it without committing if needed
Does not stash, reset, or otherwise modify the user's uncommitted changes in the main checkout
Runs a narrow baseline check in the new worktree and reports the result

evals.prompt: (You are running inside /repo/.claude/worktrees/agent-3 which your harness created for you.) Before implementing the plan, make sure you're working in an isolated worktree.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects it is already in a linked worktree and does not create another one.
expectations: Concludes it is already in a linked worktree
Reports the current worktree path and branch or detached-HEAD state

evals.prompt: We merged the hotfix. Clean up all the worktrees, there are like five of them, just force-remove everything so it's tidy.
evals.expected_output: The agent lists worktrees, removes only those it created or the user confirms, refuses to force-remove worktrees with uncommitted changes without explicit confirmation, and prunes.
expectations: Identifies worktrees with uncommitted changes or unmerged branches before removing
Asks before using --force on any worktree with uncommitted work
Does not delete unmerged branches without confirmation
